changelog: Added prohibitions on incomplete coordinate structures, prepositional phrases, and polarity-reversing elements to [Never Segment] to prevent premature emission of participants, heads, and affirmative claims.

Consolidated 11 candidate rules into 6 unified prohibitions covering: (1) coordinate structures, (2) prepositional phrase complements, (3) polarity reversals and negations, (4) scope modifiers on participles and gerunds, (5) exclusive constructions, (6) passive voice without agent.
Reordered [When to Segment] to deprioritize early-sentence boundaries and emphasize completion of dependent structures before marking.
Adjusted [Priority Rules] to rank boundaries after complete coordinate structures and polarity-settled clauses highest, and boundaries before unresolved modifiers lowest.
